about.title: Lenpak & lekip
about.p1: Lapes artizanal nouri Moris, me rezis lapes ankor lor papie ek lenformasion lamer gagn-drwat partou.
about.p2: Lamer Konekte donn peser enn asistan Morisyen-dabor: pran foto lapes, konfirm lespes, not mezir onet, verifie regleman avek sours, prepar deklarasion — mem offline.
about.team: Team Ctrl200 — Gemma 4 hackathon, Multimodal Track, pilie Ekonomi Ble.
limitation.permanent: Lamer Konekte donn dokimantasion lapes asiste par AI ek lenformasion zeneral. Bizin konfirm sizesion lespes ek verifikasion regleman avek sours ofisiel ek avek peser ouswa enn ofisie otorize.
marine.disclaimer: Previzion lamer zis pou lenformasion; kapav manke presizion pre ar lakot. Verifie avek bilten ofisiel avan sorti lor lamer.

log.empty.title: To zistwar lapes vid
log.empty.body: Sak lapes ki to anrezistre res isi — lespes, groser, dat, ek si li’nn ariv lor serveur. Li mars offline, alor to kapav anrezistre lor lamer ek sinkronize plitar.
log.noMatches.title: Okenn anrezistreman pa koresponn
log.noMatches.body: Eseye enn periode pli larz, ouswa efas filtre.
assistant.title: Regleman lapes
assistant.intro: Tou regleman anba la sorti dan mem done ki lap servi pou verifie to bann lapes. Li mars san siyal — nanye isi pa bizin koneksion.
assistant.newerRules: Serveur la ena enn version regleman pli nouvo ki seki sa app la finn garde. Rekonekte ek rearz pou met azour.
assistant.morisyenPending: * Non Morisyen pe atann verifikasion imin
assistant.rule.noVerifiedRule: Pena regleman verifie pou sa lespes la. Verifie avek dernie lavi ofisiel lapes avan debark.
assistant.rule.mantleWarning: Sa limit la mezire lor MANTLE, pa lor longer total. App la anrezistre longer total, alor sa regleman la pa kapav deside ar seki to finn met — mezir mantle la ek verifie.
assistant.guide.title: Kouma ranpli enn deklarasion
assistant.guide.mockNote: DEMONSTRASION ZIS — sa app la pa kapav fer enn vre soumision guvernman. Li montre kouma prosesis la pou marse.
assistant.guide.step1: Anrezistre sak lapes kan to debark li
assistant.guide.step1Body: Foto, konfirm lespes tomem, apre met longer mezire. Mars offline — bann anrezistreman atann dan to telefonn.
assistant.guide.step2: Verifie to zistwar avan periode la fini
assistant.guide.step2Body: Asire tou finn sinkronize ek pena anrezistreman ki ankor pe atann lor to telefonn. Korize nenport lespes ki to ti gagn tor.
assistant.guide.step3Body: Swazir bann dat. To pou trouv kantite anrezistreman, bann lespes ek total avan ki nanye ale.
assistant.guide.step4Body: To gagn enn nimero referans ek enn rezime pou inprime. Dan sa demo la soumision la similé, ek resi la dir sa.
assistant.model.checking: Pe verifie seki sa aparey la kapav fer…
assistant.model.unsupportedTitle: Sa aparey la pa kapav fer asistan la mars offline
assistant.model.noWebgpu: Sa navigater la pena sipor WebGPU, ki model lor aparey la bizin. Chrome ouswa Edge lor enn laptop ouswa telefonn Android resan kapav fer li marse.
assistant.model.noOpfs: Sa navigater la pa kapav gard gro fisye offline, alor model la pa ti pou res ant bann vizit.
assistant.model.unsupportedFallback: Nanye pa perdi — navigater regleman la ena mem bann regleman ek li mars san okenn siyal.
assistant.model.offerBody: Sa telsarz enn model lang lor to aparey pou ki to kapav poz kestion san siyal. Li opsionel.
assistant.model.factSize: telsarzman enn sel fwa. Servi Wi-Fi si to kapav — sa gro lor done mobil.
assistant.model.factOnce: Telsarze enn fwa, apre garde lor sa aparey la.
assistant.model.factTextOnly: Text zis — li pa kapav get foto.
assistant.model.factPrivate: Mars net lor to aparey. To bann kestion zame sorti.
assistant.model.lowStorage: Sa aparey la kapav pena ase plas lib.
assistant.model.declineHint: Si to pas sa, navigater regleman la ankor reponn lor limit groser ek sezon ferme offline.
assistant.model.downloadingNote: To kapav kontinie servi res app la. Pa ferm sa tab la.
assistant.model.readyBody: Model la garde lor sa aparey la. Li mars san siyal.
assistant.model.errorBody: Model la pa ti kapav telsarze. Verifie to koneksion ek reseye, ouswa servi navigater regleman.
assistant.chat.title: Poz enn kestion
assistant.chat.ungroundedWarning: Pankor konekte ar done regleman. Bann repons isi pa verifie ek kapav gagn tor lor regleman Morisien — get tab Regleman pou tou seki inportan.
assistant.chat.emptyHint: Poz nenport kestion. Bann repons zenere lor sa aparey la.
assistant.chat.failed: Sa repons la pa ti kapav zenere.
assistant.chat.loadingNote: Sarz model la dan memwar pran detrwa segonn.
assistant.chat.errorTitle: Asistan la pa ti kapav demare
assistant.chat.errorBody: Model la lor sa aparey la me li pann sarze. Navigater regleman la ankor mars bien.
assistant.chat.rulesPointer: Pou limit groser ek sezon ferme, tab Regleman la se sours laverite.
assistant.chat.groundedNote: Bann repons sorti zis dan done regleman sa app la, zame dan memwar model la. Referans regleman montre pou ki to kapav verifie tomem.
assistant.chat.outOfScope: Mo kapav zis reponn depi regleman lapes sa app la — limit groser, sezon ferme, sink lespes dan katalog la, ek kouma ranpli enn deklarasion. Mo pena lenformasion lor sa, alor mo prefer dir sa ki devine.
assistant.chat.scopeSize: Groser minimum — "ki groser mo kapav gard enn ourite?"
assistant.chat.scopeDeclaration: Deklarasion — "kouma mo soumet mo bann lapes?"
pillars.title: Pilie lekonomi ble
pillars.intro: Sis pilie nasional lekonomi ble lor enn sel kolonn vertebral Gemma. Sak pilie dir kot so done sorti, ki fre li ete, ek ki li pa kouver.
pillars.offlineNote: Pe montre lalis pilie garde dan sa app la — serveur pa ti kapav zwenn, alor stati kapav finn sanze depi sa build la.
finance.title: Verifie enn kad obligasion (bond)
finance.intro: Lir enn dokiman kad obligasion 'blue-bond' ouswa ESG ek verifie li kont bann kriter ki sorti kot ICMA. Model la zis propoz bann fe avek enn paz ek enn sitasion; sa app-la verifie sak sitasion kont vre text la ek kalkil sak rezilta an kod. Li zame donn enn verdik reisi/echwe lor enn bond.
finance.noFindingsBody: Dataset kriter la pa retourn okenn antre.
finance.advisoryOnly: (bon prartik rekomande, pa enn kondision striktman obligatwar)
pillars.notFoundBody: Nanye pa anrezistre anba sa id la:
pillars.kind.sampleWarning: Sa enn esantiyon garde, pa kondision aktyel.
pillars.kind.syntheticWarning: Done zenere — pa enn obzervasion nanye. Pa lir sa kouma vre kondision.
pillars.coverageMissing: Pena not kouvertir — sa enn vyolasion kontra, konsider rezilta la kouma pa verifie.
pillars.badgeRefBody: Bann exanp sak etiket, montre isi kouma referans. Sa pa bann rezilta depi okenn pilie.
tourism.title: Kondision sit
tourism.intro: Previzion leta lamer ek divan pou bann sit resif ek laplaz. Bann chif sorti Open-Meteo; bann nivo konvenabilite kalkile depi bann sey fixe, pa ekrir par enn model.
tourism.computedNote: Sak nivo anba kalkile depi bann chif anler kont bann sey fixe. Sey la montre pou ki to kapav verifie rezilta la tomem.
tourism.interpretationNote: Ekrir par model lang depi bann chif anler. Li pa kapav sanz okenn mezir ouswa nivo. Pa konsey sekirite.
tourism.noInterpretation: Pena brief ekri — model lang pa ti kapav zwenn. Bann chif ek nivo anler pa afekte.
tourism.noCache: Pena kondision garde lor sa aparey la ankor, ek serveur pa kapav zwenn. Ouver sa paz la enn fwa kan to online ek li pou res lizib offline.
energy.title: Resours vag ek divan
energy.intro: Previzion densite pwisans vag ek divan lor bann pwen kandida lor lakot. Toulede chif kalkile dan Python depi valer Open-Meteo; model lang ekrir komanter ek li pa kapav prodwir ouswa sanz enn chif.
energy.formulasTitle: Kouma sa bann chif la prodwir
energy.formulasNote: Inprime pou ki to kapav rekalkil nenport chif lor sa paz la ar lame depi bann valer montre akote.
energy.nearshore: Pre kot — formil dilo profon exazere
energy.interpretationNote: Ekrir par model lang depi bann chif kalkile anler. Li pa kapav sanz okenn chif. Pa enn evaliasion prodiksion.
energy.unavailable: Chif resours pa ti kapav sarze. Sa pilie la bizin backend; pena kopi offline parski enn vie chif pwisans pou trompe.
pillars.dataSummary: Done lor bann pilie an direk:
map.ariaLabel: Kart Moris avek bann landrwa marke. Enn lalis navigab par klavie ar mem bann landrwa swiv.
map.sunlightNote: Kart la pa desine dan mod Soley, ki fer pou soley direk lor enn pon. Tou bann landrwa dan lalis anba.
tourism.siteListLabel: Bann sit touristik, pli bon kondision anpremie
transport.approachListLabel: Por ek bann arive atann par distans
tourism.readingFromTail: depi sit la, deor resif — lagon pou pli kalm
energy.answerLead: {site} se pli bon kandida zordi, avek enn densite pwisans vag indike {value} kW/m.
energy.answerNoData: Pena okenn chif pwisans vag ki ti kapav prodwir pou okenn sit kandida — bann done previzion pa ti disponib.
energy.figureAt10m: divan mezire a 10 m, pa oter mwaye
energy.barCaption: Longer bar la relatif ar sit pli for ki montre, pa enn lesel absoli. Densite pwisans vag an kW par met kret.
energy.limitsTitle: Seki sa pa pran an kont
energy.limitNearshore: Tou bann pwen kandida pre kot. Formil dilo profon exazer pwisans vag dan dilo bas, alor sa bann chif la pa konparab ar bann atlas resours dilo profon pibliye.
catch.aiDisclaimerBody: Lenformasion zenere par AI zis pou ed pran desizion ek kapav ena erer. Bizin verifie lespes, mezir, regleman ek kondision lamer avek sours ofisiel. AI pa ranplas zizman bann ofisie otorize ek pa garanti sekirite ouswa konformite legal.
